--- alter_queue_drop_ttl.sql
ALTER QUEUE Q DROP ROW DELETION POLICY

--- AST
&ast.AlterQueue{
  Name: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 12,
    NameEnd: 13,
    Name:    "Q",
  },
  QueueAlteration: &ast.DropRowDeletionPolicy{
    Drop:   14,
    Policy: 32,
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER QUEUE Q DROP ROW DELETION POLICY
